name: Appetite warm
summary: Tomato red with cream surfaces. Reads as energetic and appetizing.
guidance: Warm reds and oranges are linked with appetite and urgency, so they are common in food and retail. Keep red for brand, and use a different icon plus text for errors.
Body text needs 4.5:1 against its background; large text and UI outlines need 3:1.
Use primary-text only on primary fills. Do not place text-secondary on primary or accent.
Never rely on color alone to show state (for example error versus success); add an icon or text.
